shared_contract.intended_user: To be validated with the user; no military user interviews claimed.
shared_contract.human_decision: Approve task scope and consequential outputs.
shared_contract.review_rule: Independent review when practical; user accepts consequential changes.

workstreams.problem: Overall capability architecture and honest application evidence.
workstreams.acceptance: Every major claim has an evidence category and unresolved gaps.

workstreams.problem: Reusable identity, provenance, task and compute-job boundaries.
workstreams.acceptance: One bounded contract and reproducible nonsensitive job design.

workstreams.problem: Authorized administrative workflow discovery and assistance.
workstreams.acceptance: Baseline time, corrections and operator review are specified.

workstreams.problem: Source-linked knowledge products and technical briefs.
workstreams.acceptance: Claims link to allowed sources; contradictions and unknowns remain visible.

workstreams.problem: Timestamped uncertainty estimates and outcome evaluation.
workstreams.acceptance: Point-in-time evidence, resolution rules and baseline scoring.

workstreams.problem: Synthetic training scenarios and repeatable evaluation.
workstreams.acceptance: Document assumptions and measure transfer instead of promising percentages.
Missing/stale data cases and source traceability are specified.
non_goals: No live operational footage or flight control

workstreams.acceptance: Transparent inputs, uncertainty and neutral alternatives.
Every proposed pilot has pass/fail tests and failure reporting.

workstreams.problem: Human-AI collaboration and alternative agent coordination.
workstreams.acceptance: Compare a bounded baseline against an alternative under fixed criteria.
non_goals: No experimental agent changes to human authority
